description: Read the original Dutch text of one article/section of a Dutch regulation, by BWB id and article number (e.g. "1:3", as listed by nl_wetten_get_law), as it read on "as_of" (default today). Returns the full article text broken into its numbered "lid" (paragraph) subdivisions, the date that exact text took effect, and the toestand's validity period as separate fields. Pass an earlier as_of to read a past version of the same article.

article.description: Article number as it appears in the law, e.g. "1:3", "6:162", "5".

as_of.description: Read the article as it stood on this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

name: nl_wetten_get_article
title: Nl Wetten Get Article
